investinglive_sep18.title: FX option expiries for 18 September 10am New York cut
investinglive_sep18.author: Justin Low · investingLive
investinglive_sep18.thesis: Large NY-cut FX option expiries are short-term context, not directional signals. When bold notionals bracket spot, price often stays stickier inside that band unless a macro catalyst overwhelms dealer hedging flows.

levels_called_out.note: Bold expiries sandwiching spot — containment / pin risk in the 1.1450–1.1500 region.
Spot near the figure after BOJ — short-term gravity / chop into the cut.
$5.5bn is eye-catching but >200 pips away — ignore unless a sharp reversal closes the distance.

how_to_use: Treat bold strikes as magnets only while they are near spot into the 10:00 New York cut.
Prefer range / mean-reversion playbooks inside a bracket (e.g. EURUSD 1.1450–1.1500) when macro is calm.
Stand down the pin thesis if bonds sell off hard or another catalyst overwhelms flows.
After the cut, drop the assumption that the strike still matters.
In FMC: open Whales → Plot on chart → journal the reaction (pin / slice / ignore).
investinglive_sep18.quote: These levels are best treated as short-term market context rather than directional signals. A meaningful macro catalyst… can easily overwhelm the expiry-related flows.

sections.heading: 3. Synthesis — when both speak
sections.body: Wireframe literature answers ‘where is the dealing-range scaffold?’ Expiry boards answer ‘where might dealers pin for a few hours into NY 10:00?’ On 18 Sep 2026, EURUSD’s bold 1.1450 / 1.1500 bracket is a containment day thesis. If your PO3 dealing range also respects that band, favour mean-reversion / fade-the-edge until a macro catalyst (bonds, Fed follow-through) invalidates the pin.
bullets: Overlap mean threshold with whale strike → higher-confidence range trade.
No overlap + far whale (USDJPY 155.00) → ignore; trade structure/GEX instead.
Catalyst day → drop both pin and mean-reversion; switch to breakout playbooks.

sections.heading: 4. Desk protocol (12-min study ritual)
sections.body: Twelve-minute daily pass before London / NY overlap.
bullets: Open Study → skim the PO3 / wireframe brief (dealing range + mean).
Open Whales → confirm today’s bold strikes (or last weekday board on weekends).
Mark overlaps on the chart (Whales + manual wireframe notes).
Journal one sentence + tag; Experience Replay later weights what actually paid.
